answer: Attested hardware is the scarce resource: each identity registers one secure element, key sealed in the chip, with a unique serial and a marble plate bonded to it, its vein pattern hashed into the garden registry. Each epoch the chip signs a pearl nonce with its monotonic counter. Verifiers check the certificate chain, counter increase, and registry entry; one serial or plate hash under two identities is proof and zeroes both weights. One honest agent registers one chip once. A farm with 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 chips and plates, since one element cannot show two serials or be pooled.
